item.title: Chinese chipmaker Enflame 4,073 times oversubscribed in Shanghai IPO amid Nvidia race
item.description: Enflame Technology, one of China’s leading AI chipmakers, has sparked a retail frenzy for its 6.12 billion yuan (US$910.9 million) initial public offering (IPO) in Shanghai’s tech-heavy Star Market, underscoring growing investor appetite for home-grown alternatives to Nvidia. item.title: Iran targets US bases in Kuwait despite warnings from Trump
item.description: Iran attacked US military bases in Kuwait on Thursday, despite US President Donald Trump threatening further strikes in a fresh flare-up six months into the war. Trump said his military was prepared to attack Iran “any time we want” after extensive US bombardment of sites across the country left at least 19 Iranians dead. item.title: Operators of over 60% of subdivided flats apply for 3-year grace period to meet rules
item.description: Operators of over 60 per cent of subdivided flats in Hong Kong have applied for a three-year grace period to give themselves more time to comply with a regulatory regime rolled out six months ago, the housing minister has said. item.title: Luxury homes in Singapore’s largest money laundering case hit the auction block
item.description: Another 14 luxury condominium units and a grade A office at Suntec Tower One forfeited in connection with Singapore’s largest money laundering case will be put up for sale at auctions this month.
